| **📏 [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) 1**             |      **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might):**

- **≤11:** 10 + M damage
- **12-16:** 14 + M damage
- **17+:** 20 + M damage

**Effect:** Until the end of the encounter, whenever any ally deals damage to a target judged by you, that ally gains 1 [surge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/surge).
